Couple of technical checkpoints I'll cover in the workshop — adding here so Linda & Marco can preview:
- Data delivery: minimal sample (5k records) to validate formatting, plus 2–3 edge cases
- Environment parity: staging endpoint with identical model variant and quantization profile
- KV cache / session behavior: how long sessions persist and whether we need sticky routing
- Observability: token-level cost reporting enabled + a lightweight NRT dashboard for errors

If Crestline can provision sample data and a staging bucket by 9/3, I can have the test harness and a smoke-run completed by 9/9. That keeps the pilot start of 9/10 realistic.
